evidence.text: Products of step functions vanish exactly when their induced time ordering contains a directed loop. The proof relates these loops to polarized energy poles, then uses polynomial continuation to obtain an identity for arbitrary abstract polar numbers.

Pairwise cancellation at the lowest-time vertex establishes a coordinate-space identity; independence of exponential factors isolates surviving monomials.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: Can the fields responsible for uplifting an AdS vacuum also improve cosmological capture of a modulus, despite a steep potential and nearby runaway direction? The paper tests this with one complex modulus, one complex hidden matter field and an independently conserved fluid.

sources.title: Global Fits of the Large Volume String Scenario to WMAP5 and Other Indirect Constraints Using Markov Chain Monte Carlo

evidence.text: Can the minimal Large Volume Scenario fit the paper's cosmological, electroweak, flavour and direct-search constraints, and how do the preferred parameters depend on priors and the sign of μ?

sources.title: Cosmology of F-theory GUTs

evidence.text: Can the restricted particle-physics parameters of F-theory GUTs satisfy gravitino dark-matter, BBN and baryon-asymmetry constraints, particularly through the cosmological evolution of the supersymmetry-breaking axion supermultiplet?

sources.title: SUSY without the Little Hierarchy

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric pseudo-Goldstone Higgs receive a sufficiently large quartic interaction without a corresponding large quadratic term, reducing the little-hierarchy tuning while allowing light stops and satisfying the paper's precision and perturbativity requirements?

sources.title: Mirage in the Sky: Non-thermal Dark Matter, Gravitino Problem, and Cosmic Ray Anomalies

evidence.text: Can late modulus or gravitino decay produce the correct abundance of TeV-scale, strongly annihilating dark matter, address cosmological moduli/gravitino problems, and explain the cosmic-ray anomalies discussed in 2009?

sources.title: A Non-thermal WIMP Miracle

evidence.text: Can the simple solution of making gravitationally coupled moduli heavy enough to decay before BBN also produce the observed dark-matter abundance through nonthermal WIMPs, and what supersymmetric spectrum does that suggest?

sources.title: Randall-Sundrum and Strings

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically viable string completions of Randall–Sundrum electroweak compositeness place string resonances parametrically above KK resonances, once Standard Model perturbativity and confinement-transition cosmology constrain the strong sector?

sources.title: Dark Energy density in Split SUSY models inspired by degenerate vacua

evidence.text: Can a physical SUSY-breaking vacuum, assumed degenerate with a second initially supersymmetric vacuum, inherit a small positive dark-energy density generated by strong dynamics in that second phase, and what Split SUSY scales would reproduce the paper's observational target?

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: How do the characteristics and stabilization of anomalous-U(1) D-flat directions determine the relative contributions of modulus, gauge, anomaly and D-term mediation in vacua with nearly vanishing cosmological constant?

sources.title: Higgs mass implications on the stability of the electroweak vacuum

evidence.text: Under the December 2011 Higgs-mass hypothesis 124–126 GeV, what are the Standard Model vacuum stability and metastability bounds, and what do they imply for reheating, thermal leptogenesis, and heavy right-handed neutrinos?

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Under what conditions can gauge-mediated supersymmetry breaking survive early-universe evolution: selection of a metastable SUSY-breaking vacuum, decay of the spurion, thermal stability of a volume modulus, and acceptable gravitino production?

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Which versions of type IIB LVS remain phenomenologically viable after imposing effective-supergravity validity, flavor constraints, nonperturbative matter couplings and cosmology? The author argues that a sequestered scenario with Weyl-anomaly and RG-generated soft terms is favored.

sources.title: A Gravitino-rich Universe

evidence.text: Can high-scale supersymmetry support a viable gravitino-rich or gravitino-dominated early Universe, including entropy production, dark matter and baryogenesis, and which production mechanisms realize it?

sources.title: Evidence of the Big Fix

evidence.text: Does the proposed Big Fix maximum-entropy principle receive model evidence from late-universe radiation being maximized near the observed Higgs expectation value, when current quark masses, gauge couplings and the Higgs self-coupling are held fixed?

sources.title: Confronting the moduli-induced lightest-superpartner problem

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector extensions of the MSSM avoid excessive LSP production or annihilation signals following reheating by string-motivated, Planck-coupled moduli?

sources.title: Weak Scale From the Maximum Entropy Principle

evidence.text: Can maximizing the final radiation of a postulated closed universe select a weak scale near the observed scale when the Higgs expectation value varies while dimensionless Standard Model couplings remain fixed?

sources.title: Non-thermal CMSSM with a 125 GeV Higgs

evidence.text: Which nonthermal CMSSM/mSUGRA parameter regions satisfy radiative electroweak symmetry breaking, a Higgs mass near 125 GeV, no neutralino overproduction and the collider, cosmological and DM-search constraints used by the authors?

sources.title: Cosmological Relaxation of the Electroweak Scale

evidence.text: Can early-universe dynamics select an electroweak scale parametrically below the Higgs-sector cutoff, using technically natural small parameters without requiring new particles to cancel Higgs loops at the weak scale or an anthropic selection argument?

sources.title: Moduli mediation without moduli-induced gravitino problem

evidence.text: Can an additional light modulus dilute gravitinos and nonthermal LSPs produced by heavier-modulus decay, preserving modulus or mirage mediation in both low- and high-scale SUSY-breaking scenarios?

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects from vacuum stability and metastability in models with soft breaking of a \texorpdfstring{$U\left( 1\right)$}{lg} global symmetry

evidence.text: How do competing neutral electroweak minima constrain a softly broken U(1) two-Higgs-doublet model, its one-loop running, alignment benchmarks and scalar masses compatible with diphoton and electroweak precision fits?

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: Choose representation-matched auxiliary fields, verify their elimination reproduces the specified operator, and shift fields to diagonalize kinetic mixing. Keep all induced interactions and distinguish physical observables from gauge-dependent off-shell quantities when comparing formulations.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Solve the leading algebraic vector equation and substitute consistently into the Kähler expansion. This retains the cancellation of an unsuppressed supersymmetric extra D quartic and exposes the remaining higher-dimension terms.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: Run the physical coupling from M_Z to M_S, match the two phase couplings, and evolve the second phase to the formal zero of its inverse coupling. Change the beta coefficient whenever the light matter spectrum changes.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: Freeze local slopes and neglect expansion during conversion from stationary fields. Solve the conserved-energy system and use its limiting kinetic shares to initialize dilution. The reconstructed solution retains the velocity signs and the initial-energy factor in its hyperbolic-function time scale.

sources.title: Non-thermal Dark Matter and the Moduli Problem in String Frameworks

evidence.text: Use the stabilized supergravity mass matrix and canonical eigenstates; expand gauge kinetic functions, matter metrics and Higgs bilinears to obtain decay couplings. Include leading RG effects from top Yukawa and strong gauge interactions and compute two-body widths. Standard-model fermion and three-body channels are neglected as comparatively suppressed.

sources.title: Gauge hierarchy and metastability from Higgs-driven crunching

evidence.text: Can Higgs-driven cosmological crunching dynamically select a hierarchically small Higgs mass and a metastable electroweak vacuum, and what new physics would make the selected scale phenomenologically relevant?
